Fixes bug B-main-red-seams-lost-in-splits: Tests monkeypatch or import names their target no longer has after the package splits: ddflow.api.setup._load, services.review.git_state, reprocheck.P, enforce.P, surfaces.mcp.PROC, completion._unlanded_paths, and fixtures lacking lease fields. 16 of the 288 failing ids on main 057a4a6b0 (gate event ee9be0cdf3faaebca2413c9b5), grouped by error text: test_ci_selected_scope.py::test_the_merge_queue_integrator_asks_for_the_whole_suite, test_docs_only_task_pipeline.py::test_an_unreadable_claimed_worktree_never_lets_citations_stand_in, test_docs_only_task_pipeline.py::test_the_real_diffless_callers_use_the_diff_pipeline, test_export_safe.py::test_configured_names_are_redacted, test_gate_econ_review.py::test_a_content_line_starting_with_two_dashes_is_counted, test_mcp_on_upgrade.py::test_the_connection_survives_the_exec, test_repro_verify.py::test_the_capture_is_a_scratch_file_not_an_in_process_buffer, test_review_triage_gate.py::test_review_outcome_does_not_depend_on_git_activity_outside_the_repo, test_reviewer_trust.py::test_a_tool_written_http_reviewer_is_recorded, test_reviewer_trust.py::test_approve_lists_what_waits_and_keeps_the_note, test_reviewer_trust.py::test_approve_refuses_under_an_agent_identity[--agent], test_reviewer_trust.py::test_approve_refuses_under_an_agent_identity[env], test_reviewer_trust.py::test_approve_refuses_under_an_agent_identity[harness], test_reviewer_trust.py::test_configure_records_the_per_call_agent, test_reviewer_trust.py::test_reviewers_detect_write_records_the_per_call_agent, test_trailer_names_item.py::test_git_failing_to_parse_the_trailers_is_could_not_run

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-main-red-seams-lost-in-splits --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-main-red-seams-lost-in-splits --regression-test <test>` first).

Lane red-a scope: adds test_api_layer_reviewers, test_mcp_resources and test_gate_record_family (same split cause). The test_review_triage_gate id goes to lane red-f, so that file left this item's globs.

data.note: repoint tests at names moved by the module splits

data.claim: Every one of the 18 failures comes from a test reaching a name, attribute or source text at its pre-split location; the production behaviour each test pins still holds at the new location.
data.falsifier: A test repointed at the new seam still fails, or passes even with the guarded behaviour broken in production code.
data.mechanism: The splits turned modules into packages: review/run.py binds diff_for locally, the outcome table moved to records._gate_outcome, reprocheck and trailers run through cmdrunner and infra.git, MCP resources live in surfaces/mcp/_core.py, and mergequeue_run now reads Entry.released.
data.probe: pytest of the 11 files before and after the repoint; then mutate records._gate_outcome (ERROR to passed), _trailers (drop the not-ok return), reprocheck._one_run (drop the redirect), add a second ddflow:// literal and a stray FAMILY_HINTS import
data.probe_output: before: 18 failed, 148 passed. after: 166 passed in 47.02s. Each of the 5 mutations: the named test failed (1 failed), mutation reverted.
data.question: Are the 18 failures in these 11 test files stale seams in the tests, not defects in the code?

evidence.note: R673e701f10 CONFIRMED: 18 failed -> 166 passed on the 11 files; 5 production mutations each turned the repointed test red, then reverted.

r-small-files: tests/test_file_size_ratchet.py names only demos/scenario_mcp_orchestration.py and tests/test_coherence_coverage.py, neither touched here. No test skipped, xfailed or deleted (D-red-main-lanes-2026-11-05). Stayed in the item's globs; test_review_triage_gate.py left to lane red-f.

6358cf143: tests only, 11 files. Tests were wrong, code right: each reached a pre-split seam. Real MQ.Entry replaces the _E and None stand-ins; the review outcome table is now asserted by calling _gate_outcome; the MCP resource count scans the whole package. ruff check and format clean.

data.summary: python -m ddflow.services.roborev_branch printed 'standards: findings' and a ready `gate record --outcome failed` line for job 4068, whose text said no CONFIRMED defects and held one LOW note on a pre-existing coverage gap. It treats roborev wait exit 1 as a failed review without reading severity, so the suggested record overstates the result and the agent has to overrule it by hand.
data.title: roborev_branch proposes outcome failed for a review with only a LOW note

data.body:
Fixes bug B2bd9e8b715: python -m ddflow.services.roborev_branch printed 'standards: findings' and a ready `gate record --outcome failed` line for job 4068, whose text said no CONFIRMED defects and held one LOW note on a pre-existing coverage gap. It treats roborev wait exit 1 as a failed review without reading severity, so the suggested record overstates the result and the agent has to overrule it by hand. Found on fix-B-main-red-seams-lost-in-splits.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B2bd9e8b715 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B2bd9e8b715 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B2bd9e8b715: roborev_branch proposes outcome failed for a review with only a LOW note
